pr.body:
Clicks on letterboxed video previously used the full Canvas element rectangle. The displayed box could be missed, and a margin click could select an object and speak. Pointer input now uses the current centered `object-contain` video content rectangle; selection and ripple share the same normalized point. Invalid/unavailable geometry and margins return before hit testing.

**Author checkpoint frozen; separate independent review pending.** This is author verification, not independent PASS. No merge, auto-merge or deployment is authorized by this PR.

Only five executable files change: the pure conversion helper, click-handler wiring, fixed-reference unit tests, component regressions and real-app browser cases. Final evidence commit changes documentation/artifacts only; its executable files exactly match the validated checkpoint. BBox/mask interfaces, drawing, transparent-pixel fallback, camera/model lifecycle, scheduler/input identity, JobLock/generations, metrics and all prior assertions are preserved. No mirroring or DPR multiplication is introduced.

**Reproduction:** the unchanged final browser vectors fail twice on unmodified main and pass after repair. Native synthetic 640×480 in a wide CSS box reproduces a false margin selection/speech/ripple; native 1280×720 in a narrow CSS box reproduces a missed visible object. Final fixtures retain their colored source and verify actual video/SDK pixel samples, native DOM/CSS geometry, selection, speech interception, Canvas arcs, DPR 2 and responsive resize. A single camera acquisition and stable model creation counts are required. Independent numeric reference: 640×480 in 960×540 displays 720×540 with horizontal offset 120.

**Local validation:** Node 24.19.0 / npm 11.9.0; npm ci, typecheck, lint, **162/162** Vitest tests, build, **16/16** Playwright tests, **7/7** controls (two intact successes and five specific fault detections), staged/full-base whitespace checks all pass. Of these, 46 unit/component cases and two browser cases are new. Actual locked scripts were used. Local browser is explicit system Chromium 154.0.8037.57: matched local installation was blocked by CDN HTTP 403, with no bypass. Captured original output is archived; readable TXT whitespace normalization and earlier test-fixture failures are disclosed.

**Final-head hosted CI:** [run 40091330111 / verify job 120864445166](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40091330111/job/120864445166) **completed/success**. Actual downloaded job logs confirm checkout of exactly `be1402c793616788e81a746b6a21b03a25a5a3ec`, Node **24.19.0**, npm **11.17.0**, matched **Chromium/headless shell 156.0.8078.4 / v1248**, **162 tests**, **16 browser passes** and all **7 controls**. No local system-browser override was used in hosted CI. [Browser artifact 12558654673](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/actions/runs/40091330111/artifacts/12558654673) uploaded successfully; digest `sha256:b7e9778fed656cb61c0891d00ad7239b8bef75d7c4c668bc59014607d392252b`. Downloaded decoded job-log receipt SHA-256: `f899b6a62d91c4bea9f0291874db69af5c0a99341222629d29fcac3761a283d1`.

[Verification report and reviewer targets](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/be1402c793616788e81a746b6a21b03a25a5a3ec/docs/verification/pr05.md) · [Before/after artifacts, raw logs, exact source bindings and replay scripts](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/tree/be1402c793616788e81a746b6a21b03a25a5a3ec/docs/verification/pr05) · [Validated source hashes](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/vision-edge/blob/be1402c793616788e81a746b6a21b03a25a5a3ec/docs/verification/pr05/logs/validated-source.json).

All other remote heads, main and historical evidence PRs remain unchanged. Git fetch/readback confirms the final branch SHA/tree and a clean author checkout. The executable checkpoint's earlier successful CI is recorded only as intermediate evidence; the final receipt above targets the evidence-bearing HEAD.

Remaining limits: centered contain/no-transform CSS is the explicit geometry contract. Physical camera, real model/GPU, audible audio, mobile orientation/background behavior and public deployment equality are unverified. Existing mask fallback semantics are intentionally unchanged. PR-04 identical-content compatibility coalescing still does not prove physical camera stop; full RGBA comparison remains O(pixels) on the main thread and outside the processing-duration HUD. No identity optimization or later-phase work was started. The earlier future async lock-wakeup risk remains a later-phase nonblocking consideration.

Return this frozen HEAD/tree to the parent's separately assigned reviewer. Subsequent findings will be handled on this branch with a finding-by-finding response and a new verified checkpoint.
